Shen 268 Cortical Parcellation

Source: R/data.R
shen268_cortical.Rd

Cortical regions from the Shen 268-node functional parcellation (Shen et al., 2013). Contains 2D polygon geometry for ggseg::geom_brain() and 3D vertex indices for ggseg3d::ggseg3d().

Usage

shen268_cortical()

Value

A ggseg.formats::ggseg_atlas object (cortical).

References

Shen X et al. (2013). Groupwise whole-brain parcellation from resting-state fMRI data for network node identification. doi:10.1016/j.neuroimage.2013.05.081

See also

Other ggseg_atlases: shen268_cerebellar(), shen268_subcortical()

Examples

shen268_cortical()
#> 
#> ── shen268_cortical ggseg atlas ────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> Type: cortical
#> Regions: 206
#> Hemispheres: left, right
#> Views: inferior, lateral, superior, medial
#> Palette: ✔
#> Rendering: ✔ ggseg
#> ✔ ggseg3d (vertices)
#> ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#>    hemi     region         label
#> 1  left region 098 lh_Region_098
#> 2  left region 134 lh_Region_134
#> 3  left region 135 lh_Region_135
#> 4  left region 136 lh_Region_136
#> 5  left region 137 lh_Region_137
#> 6  left region 138 lh_Region_138
#> 7  left region 139 lh_Region_139
#> 8  left region 140 lh_Region_140
#> 9  left region 141 lh_Region_141
#> 10 left region 142 lh_Region_142
#> ... with 207 more rows
